SEARCH_SONGS.text: 輸入詩歌名稱或其中一句歌詞
SEARCH_SONGS.back: Type a song name or one line of its words
SEARCH_SONGS.why: 歌詞是詩歌的常用說法

SEARCH_SECTIONS.text: 輸入段落，如 副歌、主歌2，或一句歌詞
SEARCH_SECTIONS.back: Type a section, e.g. chorus, verse2, or one line of words
SEARCH_SECTIONS.why: 與段落標籤同寫法，數字不留空格

KIND_BIBLE.why: 譯本不是經文也不是整本書

COUNTDOWN_DETAIL.text: 投影機會顯示倒數，直到時間結束

COUNTDOWN_DETAIL.why: 投影是全程唯一的放給現場的動詞

MESSAGE_DETAIL.back: Puts these words on the projector as a message for the people in the room

CMD_NEW_SONG_DETAIL.text: 自己輸入歌詞，或貼上歌詞
CMD_NEW_SONG_DETAIL.back: Write the words or paste them in

CMD_LOOKS_DETAIL.back: Background, text style, the church's emblem

CMD_SETTINGS_DETAIL.text: 介面語言、聖經、快捷鍵和導覽
CMD_SETTINGS_DETAIL.back: Window language, Bibles, shortcut keys and tour

CMD_SCREENS_DETAIL.text: 選哪個螢幕給會眾，哪個給樂團
CMD_SCREENS_DETAIL.back: Pick which screen faces the congregation and which the band

CMD_REMOTE_DETAIL.text: 同一個 Wi-Fi 的手機可以切換投影片
CMD_REMOTE_DETAIL.back: Phones on the same Wi-Fi can change slides

CMD_IMPORT_FOLDER_DETAIL.text: 資料夾內需為 OpenLyrics 格式
CMD_IMPORT_FOLDER_DETAIL.back: The folder must hold OpenLyrics files

CMD_IMPORT_ZIP.text: 從 zip 檔匯入詩歌
CMD_IMPORT_ZIP.back: Import songs from a zip file

CMD_IMPORT_ZIP_DETAIL.text: 直接選下載的檔案，不必先解壓縮
CMD_IMPORT_ZIP_DETAIL.back: Just pick the downloaded file, no need to unpack it first

IMPORT_ZIP_EMPTY.text: 這個 zip 檔裡沒有可匯入的詩歌

CMD_IMPORT_DETAIL.text: 複製這台電腦上舊程式的詩歌和聖經
CMD_IMPORT_DETAIL.back: Copies the old program's songs and Bibles on this computer

CMD_STREAM_DETAIL.text: 把投影機的畫面傳到影音網站，或存成檔案
CMD_STREAM_DETAIL.back: Send the projector's picture to a video site, or save it as a file

BTN_STREAM.why: 按鈕與對話框同一名稱

BTN_LISTEN.why: 以看得到的麥克風命名

STREAM_HINT.text: 直播的畫面和投影機相同，還有現場收到的聲音。
STREAM_HINT.back: The broadcast has the same picture as the projector, plus the sound picked up in the room.

STREAM_KEY.why: 影音網站頁面上就叫串流金鑰

STREAM_RECORD_HINT.text: 存在這台電腦，與 Artosia 的資料放在一起
STREAM_RECORD_HINT.back: Saved on this computer, together with Artosia's data

STREAM_MISSING.back: This installation does not include the broadcast part, so broadcasting is not possible.

STREAM_NOTHING.text: 請填入直播網址，或開啟「同時錄影存檔」
STREAM_NOTHING.back: Fill in a broadcast address, or switch on "Also record to a file"

REC_HINT.back: Only the short pieces heard and the recognition guesses are kept, all in one folder on this computer.

CMD_UPDATE_DETAIL.text: 程式每次開啟時也會自動檢查

update_ready.text: 已下載新版 {version}，下次開啟程式時啟用

CMD_PREVIOUS_DETAIL.back: The projector goes back one slide

CMD_NEXT_DETAIL.text: 投影機前進一張投影片
CMD_NEXT_DETAIL.back: The projector goes forward one slide

CMD_BLACK_DETAIL.back: The projector goes all black; choose it again to bring the picture back

CMD_CLEAR_DETAIL.text: 文字消失，背景圖或影片還在
CMD_CLEAR_DETAIL.back: The words disappear; the background picture or video stays

CMD_LOGO_DETAIL.back: The church's emblem replaces the slide

CMD_UNDO_DETAIL.back: What was just removed comes back

look_own_dropped.back: "{name}" goes back to the usual design

TOUR_PLAN_MORE.back: Drag an item to change the order

TOUR_SHOW_MORE.back: The room only sees it when the projector is on

看看效果

SCREENS_HERE.back: Show the projector picture in a window on this screen

SCREENS_HERE_HINT.back: Press Esc with the pointer over it to close the window

LOOK_FONT_SEARCH.back: Type a font name to narrow the list

SCREENS_STAGE_WINDOW.text: 在獨立視窗顯示樂團畫面
SCREENS_STAGE_WINDOW.back: Show the band screen in a separate window
